snapshots.name: cellBoundaries
snapshots.meaning: H3 resolution-8 cells covering the 17 community areas (GPUCellCover, then GPUCellAggregation); boundaries from GPUCellGeometry for display

snapshots.name: tableCount
snapshots.meaning: distinct cells in the sorted table

snapshots.name: segmentRows
snapshots.meaning: table row of the cell that owns each exposed edge

snapshots.name: edgeIndices
snapshots.meaning: edge index within the owning hexagon (0 to 5)

snapshots.name: ringPositions
snapshots.meaning: closed rings of the exposed edges (shells counter-clockwise, holes clockwise), longitude/latitude degrees; unused ring slots are empty
